Coverage_Description: Bi-annual exam and scaling/polishing; unlimited consultations, intra-oral X-rays, decay-related fillings, simple extractions, office-hours emergency consultations/dressings, and medication; procedures requiring monitored anaesthetic care are excluded
pricing: HK$680 per enrolled member for 1 Apr 2025-31 Mar 2026 (enrollment form premium).
customer requirement: Swire group staff/pensioners and eligible family members (spouse, children, parents, siblings); enrollment form, staff card copy, and ID/relationship proof when requested
price structure: Flat per-member premium; non-covered services offered at 10%-40% discount
additional informations: Advance appointment required; premium is non-refundable; application processing about 5 working days
